name: Indie Appliance Repair
tagline: Find an independent technician. Skip the lead mill.
description: A directory of independent, locally owned appliance repair technicians in Phoenix, Arizona, and Riverside County, California — organized by city, appliance, and brand. We list shops you can call directly, not a lead auction.
disclosureSummary: We do not invent ratings, reviews, or prices. Facts on listing pages come from the business's own website or other public sources we record. Some pages include labeled affiliate-placement boxes, but this site does not currently use live affiliate tracking links and does not earn commissions from them. If that changes, those links will stay labeled. See our Affiliate Disclosure.
